column1: # EasyWGS multi-pathogen demonstration panel (curated and accession-verified).
# All run accessions were verified against the ENA Portal API (tiers 1-3 on 2026-09-16, tiers 4-5 on
# 2026-09-20); each row carries real WGS reads with public FASTQ links. No reads are shipped in git:
# examples/00_download_panel.sh fetches them by run accession and downsamples.
#  id            EasyWGS sample id (no spaces / extra dots); also the 00_rawdata prefix
#  group         pathogen group (salmonella/kpneumoniae/ecoli/listeria/shigella, the tier-4 groups
#  species_code  value for the samplesheet 'species' column that drives module 06
#  platform      illumina or hybrid (hybrid rows give BOTH an Illumina and an ONT run)
#  illumina_run  ENA/SRA Illumina paired-end run accession (empty for none)
#  ont_run       ENA/SRA Oxford Nanopore run accession of the SAME BioSample (empty for none)
#  biosample     BioSample that proves the Illumina and ONT runs are one isolate (hybrid rows)
#  bioproject    source study accession (documentation; download uses the run accessions)
#  date          ENA collection date (YYYY or YYYY-MM; year-only records are mid-dated in the dates file)
#  reference_gcf verified RefSeq complete-genome accession used for module 09/12
#  ref_label     local reference file produced under ref/
#  tier          smallest tier the sample belongs to (1 core=10, 2 typing breadth=20,
#                3 Salmonella temporal=29, 4 five additional pathogen groups=44,
#                5 nine additional pathogen groups=71); nested, filtered as tier<=N
